_help: Prices are in pence. A size with price null is not for sale. Set your own prices from your print company's base cost plus postage plus margin. prodigi_sku is the Prodigi product code for that size, from the Prodigi product catalogue; every size you sell needs one. digital is the emailed high-resolution file, sold for any size; set its price to null to stop selling it.
note: Printed to order. Personalised prints can't be returned unless they arrive faulty or damaged.
digital_note: Your file is made for you and emailed straight away. By paying you agree to that, and that you lose the 14-day right to cancel once it's sent.
